headlines.title: 中证协：券商出具债券投资建议时 原则上单一债券投顾账户持仓规模不超过25%
headlines.summary: 中证协制定发布《证券公司债券投资顾问业务管理规则》，旨在强化券商债券投顾业务自律管理，规范机构展业及服务模式。新规重点明确债券投顾业务持仓集中度风控要求，划定硬性监管红线：券商出具债券投资建议时，原则上不得导致单一债券投顾账户单券持仓成本，超过该账户总资产规模的25%，严控单一债券持仓集中风险。同时新规明确三类豁免情形，具体包括投资标的为国债、央行票据、政策性金融债、地方政府债、境内系统重要性银行同业存单；投顾首次服务对应账户的三个月内；因债券回售、系统重要性银行名单调整等客观因素导致的被动超限情况。

headlines.title_en: SAC: When securities firms issue bond investment advice, in principle the position size of a single bond investment advisory account should not exceed 25%
headlines.summary_en: The Securities Association of China has issued the 'Management Rules for Securities Firms' Bond Investment Advisory Business' to strengthen self-regulation of broker bond advisory operations and standardize industry practices and service models. Key rules clarify risk control requirements for position concentration in bond advisory business and set a hard regulatory red line: when brokers issue bond investment advice, they generally may not cause a single bond advisory account's cost of a single bond position to exceed 25% of the account's total asset scale, strictly controlling concentration risk in single bond holdings. The new rules also specify three categories of exemptions: investment targets including treasury bonds, central bank bills, policy financial bonds, local government bonds, and negotiable certificates of deposit of systemically important domestic banks; within three months of the advisory service's first engagement with the corresponding account; and passive limit breaches caused by objective factors such as bond resale or adjustments to the systemically important bank list.

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Finance plans to issue 2026 book-entry fixed-rate (16th tranche) government bonds, with a tender face value totaling 90 billion yuan
headlines.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance plans to issue the 2026 book-entry fixed-rate treasury bond (16th tranche). The bond is a 10-year fixed-rate coupon bond with a competitive tender face value of RMB 90 billion, with additional bidding allowed for Class A members. The coupon rate will be determined through competitive tender. Interest accrues from August 15, 2026, with semiannual interest payments on February 15 and August 15 of each year (postponed to the next business day if a holiday), and principal plus final interest repaid on August 15, 2036. Tender time: August 14, 2026, 10:35-11:35 a.m.

headlines.title: 主流房贷利率仍未跌破3% “2”字头仅是少数银行在部分地区行为
headlines.summary: 近期，一些城市传出房贷利率跌破3%、进入“2字头”的消息。今日从银行、房产中介等多方了解到，低于3%的房贷利率只是少数外资银行在部分地区推出的专属优惠，当前全国主流房贷利率仍稳定在3.0%至3.1%区间。招联首席经济学家董希淼分析称，这一低利率主要面向特定合作渠道且需通过严苛资质审批，多数普通购房者能申请到的仍是3%左右的主流市场利率。因此，2.7%左右的房贷利率是竞争“特例”，体现外资银行的灵活经营优势，而非房贷利率普遍下行信号。（中新经纬）

headlines.title_en: Mainstream mortgage rates still not below 3%; '2'-prefix rates are only seen by a few banks in certain regions
headlines.summary_en: Recently, reports emerged that some cities' mortgage rates have fallen below 3%, entering the '2% range.' Today, inquiries with banks and property agencies revealed that sub-3% mortgage rates are only exclusive offers by a few foreign banks in certain regions, and the mainstream national mortgage rate remains stable in the 3.0%-3.1% range. Dong Ximiao, chief economist at Zhaolian, analyzed that this low rate is mainly available to specific partner channels and requires strict qualification approval; most ordinary homebuyers can still obtain rates around 3%, the mainstream market level. Thus, mortgage rates around 2.7% are a competitive 'exception,' reflecting foreign banks' flexible operational advantages rather than a signal of broadly declining mortgage rates. (China News Service Economic WeChat)

headlines.title_en: Silicon Industry Branch: Current industrial silicon market is in a stage of continuously strengthening supply contraction, with the market entering a bottoming-out and repair phase
headlines.summary_en: According to the Silicon Industry Branch of the China Nonferrous Metals Industry Association, the industrial silicon market this week showed divergence with 'futures rebounding in oscillation while spot prices stabilized after declines.' Boosted by industry policy expectations and supply contraction news, futures prices briefly rose to around RMB 8,450/ton, with an overall weekly rebound of over 3%. However, spot market gains lacked follow-through, with quotes stable this week, ending several consecutive weeks of declines. Supply contraction signals continue to strengthen, with market bottom characteristics gradually emerging.

headlines.title: 国家税务总局：对境外保险收益征税并非新政策 无需过度解读
headlines.summary: 近日，有报道称中国内地税务居民购买香港保险的收益被纳入征税范围，引发关注。就此，国家税务总局相关负责人指出，按照我国个人所得税法相关规定，中国税收居民需就全球所得履行纳税义务，境外保险收益也属于应纳税所得的范畴，这并非新政策，更不是专门针对香港保险市场，无需过度解读。

headlines.title_en: State Taxation Administration: Tax on overseas insurance income is not a new policy, no need for over-interpretation
headlines.summary_en: Recently, reports surfaced that income from Hong Kong insurance policies purchased by mainland Chinese tax residents has been included in the taxable scope, drawing attention. In response, officials from the State Taxation Administration noted that under China's Individual Income Tax Law, Chinese tax residents must fulfill tax obligations on global income, and overseas insurance proceeds also fall within taxable income. This is not a new policy, nor is it specifically targeted at the Hong Kong insurance market, and should not be over-interpreted.

headlines.title: 八家硅料企业发布倡议 知情人士称或配套惩罚措施
headlines.summary: 八家光伏硅料企业签署《倡议书》，承诺不低于完全成本价销售，杜绝低价倾销，并将自查自纠、接受监管。 从知情人士处获悉，通威股份、协鑫科技、大全能源、新特能源、亚洲硅业、东方希望、青海丽豪、戈恩斯的确已于上海签署《倡议书》，共同承诺所有光伏产品销售价格（含招投标报价）均不得低于依据《光伏行业成本核算模型通则》核算的对应成本。其中一位参与《倡议书》签署的企业负责人回应记者，各大企业积极落实工信部、国家市场监督管理总局近期会议精神，“大家都是自愿倡议的。” 该人士还进一步透露，《倡议书》发布后或还会出台惩罚措施，加强自律。（21世纪经济报道）

headlines.title_en: Eight polysilicon companies issue initiative; sources say punitive measures may be attached
headlines.summary_en: Eight polysilicon companies in the photovoltaic sector have signed a proposal pledging not to sell below full cost, eliminating low-price dumping, with self-inspection and regulatory compliance. According to informed sources, Tongwei Co., GCL Technology, Daqo Energy, Xinte Energy, Asia Silicon, East Hope, Qinghai Lihao and Goens have indeed signed the proposal in Shanghai, jointly committing that all PV product sales prices (including bidding quotes) will not be lower than the corresponding costs calculated under the 'General Rules for PV Industry Cost Accounting Model.' One executive involved in the signing said companies are actively implementing the recent spirit of meetings held by the MIIT and the State Administration for Market Regulation, 'everyone signed voluntarily.' The source further revealed that punitive measures may be introduced after the proposal's release to strengthen self-discipline. (21st Century Business Herald)

headlines.title: 宇树科技王兴兴：生态黏性将使新品牌消费级机器人获客成本激增
headlines.summary: 宇树科技董事长、总经理兼首席技术官王兴兴表示，高性能通用机器人同时面向行业级和消费级的应用。对于行业级应用，电力、消防等已实现商业成熟应用的客户更倾向于具有成功落地案例的企业合作，未来在工业生产、医疗保健、应急救援等领域的应用也将由头部企业主导，市场头部效应显著。对于消费级应用，大量消费者优先考虑知名品牌的机器人产品，市场教育、品牌认知培养、品牌生态建设等都是竞争的关键环节，头部企业加速构建“硬件+软件+服务”三位一体的生态建设，逐步完善的生态黏性将使新品牌机器人的获客成本激增。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Unitree's Wang Xingxing: Ecosystem stickiness will sharply raise customer acquisition costs for new-brand consumer robots
headlines.summary_en: Wang Xingxing, Chairman, General Manager and CTO of Unitree Robotics, stated that high-performance general-purpose robots target both industrial and consumer applications. For industrial use, customers in power, firefighting and other commercially mature segments prefer companies with proven deployment cases, and future applications in industrial production, healthcare, emergency rescue and other fields will also be led by top players, with significant market consolidation at the top. For consumer applications, a large number of consumers prioritize well-known robot brands, making market education, brand awareness building and brand ecosystem development key competitive factors. Leading companies are accelerating the construction of a 'hardware + software + service' integrated ecosystem, and growing ecosystem stickiness will sharply raise customer acquisition costs for new robot brands. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 中证协：证券公司不得将客户超额收益直接作为债券投资顾问业务人员的业绩考核指标
headlines.summary: 中国证券业协会发布《证券公司债券投资顾问业务管理规则》，设置6个月过渡期，将于2027年2月5日起正式施行。其中提出，证券公司应当建立科学合理的薪酬绩效考核制度，重点考核债券投资顾问业务人员的合规展业和客户满意度等，并应将因债券投资顾问业务人员未勤勉、审慎出具投资建议给客户造成重大风险和客户投诉的情形纳入债券投资顾问业务人员的考核管理，不得将客户超额收益直接作为债券投资顾问业务人员的业绩考核指标。

headlines.title_en: Securities Association of China: Securities firms must not directly use clients' excess returns as performance assessment indicators for bond investment advisory staff.
headlines.summary_en: The Securities Association of China has issued the 'Management Rules for Securities Firms' Bond Investment Advisory Business,' setting a six-month transition period with formal implementation from February 5, 2027. It states that securities firms should establish a scientific and reasonable compensation and performance appraisal system, focusing on compliance and customer satisfaction in the performance of bond investment advisory personnel. Situations where advisory personnel cause significant customer risks or complaints due to failure to diligently and prudently issue investment advice should be included in their performance assessment. Customer excess returns should not be directly used as a performance evaluation indicator for bond investment advisory personnel.

headlines.title: 华电新能：控股股东29%股份无偿划转协议已签署，尚需上交所合规确认
headlines.summary: 华电新能公告，公司控股股东华电福瑞与中国华电于2026年8月5日签署了《上市公司国有股份无偿划转协议》，华电福瑞拟将其所持华电新能120.97亿股股份（占公司总股本的29%）无偿划转至中国华电。本次划转完成后，公司控股股东将由华电福瑞变更为中国华电，实际控制人未发生变更。截至公告日，本次无偿划转事项尚需取得上海证券交易所的合规性确认及在中国证券登记结算有限责任公司上海分公司完成过户登记程序。

headlines.title_en: Huadian New Energy: Agreement for free transfer of 29% of controlling shareholder's shares has been signed, pending compliance confirmation from the Shanghai Stock Exchange.
headlines.summary_en: Huadian New Energy announced that its controlling shareholder, Huadian Furu, signed the "State-Owned Shares Gratuitous Transfer Agreement" with China Huadian on August 5, 2026, under which Huadian Furu plans to transfer 12.097 billion shares of Huadian New Energy (29% of the company's total share capital) to China Huadian free of charge. Upon completion of the transfer, the company's controlling shareholder will change from Huadian Furu to China Huadian, with no change in actual controller. As of the announcement date, the transfer is still subject to compliance confirmation from the Shanghai Stock Exchange and completion of transfer registration procedures with the Shanghai Branch of China Securities Depository and Clearing Corporation.

headlines.title: 国家外汇局：截止7月末我国外汇储备规模为34188亿美元，升幅0.07%
headlines.summary: 国家外汇管理局统计数据显示，截至2026年7月末，我国外汇储备规模为34188亿美元，较6月末上升25亿美元，升幅为0.07%。 2026年7月，受全球宏观形势、主要经济体货币政策等因素影响，美元指数下跌，全球主要金融资产价格涨跌互现。汇率折算和资产价格变化等因素综合作用，当月外汇储备规模上升。我国经济呈现动能向新、结构向优的发展态势，展现出强大韧性和活力，有利于外汇储备规模保持基本稳定。

headlines.title_en: State Administration of Foreign Exchange: As of end-July, China's foreign exchange reserves stood at $3,418.8 billion, up 0.07%.
headlines.summary_en: According to statistics from the State Administration of Foreign Exchange, as of the end of July 2026, China's foreign exchange reserves stood at $3.4188 trillion, up $2.5 billion from the end of June, an increase of 0.07%. In July 2026, influenced by global macroeconomic conditions and monetary policies of major economies, the U.S. dollar index declined while global major financial asset prices showed mixed movements. Comprehensive effects of exchange rate translation and asset price changes led to a rise in foreign exchange reserves for the month. China's economy is showing a trend of new momentum and improved structure, demonstrating strong resilience and vitality, which is conducive to maintaining basic stability in the scale of foreign exchange reserves.
